identity.name: Perpetual Calendar
identity.one_liner: The 2017 white-gold perpetual calendar with the in-house 324 SQ calibre, day/date/month/moon phase/24-hour/leap-year on the dial — the most-cited Patek perpetual of the late 2010s.

provenance_events.description: Patek Philippe releases the 5320G with the in-house 324 SQ automatic perpetual calendar calibre, in a 40mm white-gold case.

narrative.story: The 5320G is the modern Patek perpetual calendar: 40mm white gold, automatic 324 SQ movement, day/date/month/moon phase/24-hour/leap-year in a clean sub-dial layout. The dial is a 12-hour counter concentric with the moon phase.
narrative.collector_notes: The 324 SQ is the same family as the 324 S Q in the 5320J (yellow gold) and 5320R (rose gold).
